summary: All 7 acceptance criteria exercised: 6 backend tests (pytest, real HTTP against localhost:8001) + 7 browser checks (Playwright via run_browser_script). All passed. Public ingress URL verified against https://kafka-processor.preview.emergentagent.com. Shared seeded rows (alert-lag, stream global state) were reset to their documented seed state after mutation-heavy checks to leave the environment clean for rerun.

checks.name: test_tscheck_pipeline_resources.py
checks.evidence: POST /api/pipelines with tscheck-source-* -> 200, created row with kind=source protocol=Kafka partitions=5 retention_days=10 present in subsequent GET /api/pipelines; POST with invalid protocol -> 422

checks.criterion: Operators can acknowledge and resolve alerts
checks.name: test_tscheck_alert_ack_resolve.py
checks.evidence: GET /api/alerts confirms seeded alert-lag status=active, severity=P1, acknowledged_at/resolved_at null; POST /api/alerts/alert-latency/resolve with empty note -> 422 (validation rule). Kept read-only on alert-lag so the browser check owns the single ack->resolve mutation on that seeded singleton.

checks.criterion: Operators can pause and resume the stream safely
checks.name: test_tscheck_stream_pause_resume.py
checks.evidence: POST /api/stream/pause -> 200 {status:paused}; GET /api/stream reflects paused; POST /api/stream/resume -> 200 {status:running}; GET /api/stream reflects running

checks.criterion: Operators can manage external connection profiles safely
checks.name: test_tscheck_integration_connection_config.py
checks.evidence: GET /api/integrations returns kafka/redis/timescaledb all credential_state=placeholder; POST /api/integrations/{timescale-id}/test -> 200 {ok:false, mocked:true, detail:non-empty}

checks.criterion: The operations console presents a dark, dense pipeline overview with live metrics, topology, health, and incident count
checks.name: overview-shows-live-pipeline-console
checks.evidence: Desktop viewport: metric cards (GLOBAL EVENT RATE, P99 LATENCY, CONSUMER LAG, active-incidents testid), 4 topology nodes (pipeline-node-source/queue/processor/sink), health rows (Kafka cluster, Redis cache, Worker pool), and Active incidents heading all visible with no thrown errors

checks.name: sources-add-new-source
checks.evidence: Sources & Consumers lists orders.ingress/enrichment-worker with protocol/status/partitions/rate/lag/retention columns; Add source dialog with unique tscheck-source-<ts> name submitted via 'Add resource' button and the new row appeared in the list

checks.name: events-inspector-filters-and-payload
checks.evidence: event-stream-log-row-0 visible; level filter (event-stream-level-filter select) to WARN surfaces cache.backpressure; search filter for 'cache' surfaces same row; clicking a row populates event-payload-inspector testid with formatted JSON including order_id

checks.criterion: Operators can acknowledge and resolve alerts
checks.name: alerts-acknowledge-and-resolve
checks.evidence: alert-card-0 (alert-lag) starts status-badge-active; Acknowledge click -> status-badge-acknowledged and Acknowledge button removed; Resolve opens dialog whose submit button (resolve-dialog-submit-button) is disabled until a note is typed, then submitting shows status-badge-resolved plus the note text on the card

checks.criterion: Operators can pause and resume the stream safely
checks.name: stream-pause-requires-confirmation-then-resume
checks.evidence: Pause All opens confirmation dialog; submit button stays disabled for wrong text and only enables after typing exact 'CONFIRM PAUSE'; after submit the paused banner (banner-resume-button) appears and header status changes from LIVE; clicking stream-pause-resume-button restores LIVE · ALL SYSTEMS NOMINAL and removes the banner

checks.criterion: Operators can manage external connection profiles safely
checks.name: connections-save-profile-and-mocked-test
checks.evidence: Connection & storage config lists Kafka cluster/Redis cache/TimescaleDB archive placeholder profiles; Save connector profile with unique tscheck-connector-<ts> name persists and renders a new card; Test connection on the TimescaleDB placeholder (connection-test-button-timescaledb) surfaces toast 'External credentials are placeholders; connection test is not active in this environment' -- mocked/unavailable, not a claimed live success

checks.criterion: Public ingress and API routing work
checks.name: public-ingress-loads-console
checks.evidence: Navigated to https://kafka-processor.preview.emergentagent.com; STREAMPULSE header and Pipeline overview heading render; reload triggers GET .../api/overview -> 200 and GLOBAL EVENT RATE metric renders, confirming /api routing works through the public ingress

action_items: note: acceptance_matrix has 7 criteria; 4 API-bearing criteria received both a backend test file and a browser check (11 artifacts total across 7 criteria), matching the 'both lanes for API-backed UI criteria' rule.

note: alert-lag and the global stream-state are shared singleton seeded rows exercised by both a backend test and a browser check for the same criterion; to avoid double-mutating the same row across lanes, the backend alert test was scoped to read-only + a validation-only mutation on a different alert id, leaving the full ack->resolve UI flow as the single owner of that mutation on alert-lag. Both stream-pause and alert-lag state were reset to their documented seed values after the test run.
